rationale: TLK is an Indonesian ADR with nearly 1 billion float shares trading in a dead 1-cent range ($11.61–$11.62) over the last five minutes on only 3,000 to 5,000 shares per minute. With a 5-minute ATR of just $0.03 and a 1-cent bid-ask spread consuming a third of that volatility, there is insufficient intraday movement after the morning gap to overcome transaction costs in either direction.
